threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on legacy POS servers captures card data at 72 outlets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool outside PAM; no EDR; clear text card data in memory
treatment_plan: Vendor through PAM; compensating segment monitoring; P2PE replacement

threat_event: Card data captured at the 17 front desks without validated P2PE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Semi-integrated terminals at 17 managed hotels
existing_controls: Chip terminals; EDR on front desk PCs
treatment_plan: P2PE terminals at the 17 hotels
owner: Hotels division payments and systems director

threat_event: The CRS integration service account is used to read guest and owner data from the profile hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credential stored on legacy POS servers and interface services; reads every hub table
treatment_plan: Restrict scope; rotate; remove the credential from legacy POS servers
owner: Hotels division payments and systems director

threat_event: An attacker uses the lock vendor's default administrator password to encode room keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found the default administrator password on 14 lock servers at managed hotels
existing_controls: Lock servers on a separate VLAN at owned hotels
treatment_plan: Change all lock server passwords; add lock servers to the hardening scan; vendor access through PAM

threat_event: Phishing gives an attacker a front desk PMS account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large front office workforce
existing_controls: MFA on every PMS sign-in; phishing exercises
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for front office by 2027

threat_event: Callers at the front desk or contact center obtain guest details or room keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High call volume; pressure to serve guests quickly
treatment_plan: Verification checks in the PMS before key issue; quarterly call tests

threat_event: Card authorization forms by email at managed hotels leak card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 managed hotels still accept emailed forms
treatment_plan: Stop emailed forms at the 6 hotels; mailbox scan and purge

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts hotel workstations and lock servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat legacy segments at older managed hotels
treatment_plan: Segment the 11 remaining flat hotels

threat_event: The PMS vendor suffers a multi-hour outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One PMS vendor for 88 hotels
treatment_plan: Contract recovery objectives; quarterly downtime drills

threat_event: Legacy POS servers run an unsupported operating system after 2027-01-31
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replacement due 2027-06-30, after end of support
treatment_plan: Prioritize the 23 hotels before 2027-01-31 or buy extended support
owner: Hotels vice president of food and beverage

threat_event: A skimming overlay is placed on an outlet terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly inspections at legacy POS hotels
treatment_plan: Weekly inspections per the targeted risk analysis; inspection training
owner: Hotels vice president of food and beverage

threat_event: Devices missing from the inventory go uninspected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hand-kept lists at 17 managed hotels; 64 unmatched devices
treatment_plan: Central device inventory from the POS and P2PE portals
owner: Hotels division payments and systems director

threat_event: An owner's corporate network is used as a path into the PMPS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interconnections at 9 managed hotels
treatment_plan: Interconnection agreements and rule review

threat_event: A breach at a managed hotel leaves owner notice and cost duties unclear
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 older management agreements silent on security
treatment_plan: Owner addendum; notice list in P08
owner: Hotels senior vice president of owner relations

threat_event: The guest chatbot quotes nightly rates without the mandatory resort fee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fee data not passed to the chatbot for 6 resort hotels
existing_controls: Website and app show total price
treatment_plan: Total price in every chatbot rate answer; weekly test set

threat_event: Automated pricing raises rates sharply during a declared emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-publish on at 30 owned and 49 managed hotels; no emergency rule for managed hotels
existing_controls: Emergency freeze at owned hotels since 2025
treatment_plan: Emergency mode for all hotels in declared areas; owner consent
owner: Hotels vice president of revenue management

threat_event: Pricing software shares non-public data among competing hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor product includes a pooled benchmarking feature (switched off 2026-08)
treatment_plan: Annual confirmation; counsel review of vendor terms
owner: Hotels vice president of revenue management

threat_event: A guest Wi-Fi or IPTV compromise affects guests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-managed guest networks separated from staff and payment segments
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Hotels security and compliance lead

threat_event: Loyalty accounts are taken over and points redeemed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optional MFA for members
treatment_plan: Step-up MFA for redemptions (group plan GR-10)

threat_event: Identity document numbers kept indefinitely are exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 7.9 million ID numbers in SYS-G5
treatment_plan: Delete ID numbers 30 days after checkout (group plan GR-14)

threat_event: A front office user with card-display rights misuses guarantee card numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 42 accounts can display full card numbers
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of the 42 accounts
owner: Hotels division payments and systems director

threat_event: Legacy POS vendor patch delays leave known flaws open
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly vendor patching; 9 servers missed 2026 Q2
treatment_plan: Monthly patch reporting; contract penalty
owner: Hotels vice president of food and beverage

threat_event: A hurricane cuts connectivity to Florida hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 26 Florida hotels
treatment_plan: Satellite backup at the 3 resort hotels (group plan GR-15)

threat_event: The tone-masking service fails and agents hear card numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single tone-masking provider
existing_controls: Provider AOC; failure alert pauses card capture
treatment_plan: Quarterly failover test

threat_event: Owners cannot show which PCI DSS requirements the division meets for them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Responsibility matrix not sent to all 41 ownership groups
existing_controls: Service provider AOC available on request
treatment_plan: Send AOC and matrix to every owner each year
owner: Group Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: A malicious script on a booking page captures card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Booking engine embeds the hosted payment form
existing_controls: Script inventory and tamper detection on brand booking pages
treatment_plan: Keep weekly script review
